title: Mommy and Me!
seo_title: Mommy & Me Thanksgiving Music Class in Joplin, MO
description: Mommy & Me is a Thanksgiving-themed fall music class led by Miss Chelsea at Baylee's Music Academy, where little ones sing, dance, and join playful activities with their grown-ups. It is for children ages 6 months to 4 years with a parent or grown-up, and Miss Chelsea (MS, CCC-SLP) brings a speech-language pathology background to the class. It takes place November 21, 2026, Time TBD, at 5065 N Main St Rd in Joplin, MO; message the academy to ask about available spots.
